title: Maintenance due reminder
description: Remind drivers their vehicle is due for maintenance by mileage or date. Marketing WhatsApp template that drives service bookings.
notes: Because it invites a booking not yet made, treat it as marketing and include opt-out. Use last service date to show relevance.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your {{vehicle}} is due for its {{interval}} service. Regular maintenance keeps it safe and protects resale value. Book a slot that fits your week.
